revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay the bank on its residential, commercial and multi-family real estate loans, and the bank earns yield on its securities.
revenueModel.evidence: Subject to market conditions and our asset-liability analysis, we expect to continue to focus on commercial and multi-family real estate lending as part of our effort to diversify the loan portfolio and increase the overall yield earned on our loans.
